Studios

## One studio to host all of your customers

Launch a course, a paid community, or both, inside one branded Studio your members can pay to join.

Play sound

Funnel Builder

## Describe what you want to sell. AI builds the entire sales journey for you.

Trained on tens of thousands of real, high-converting sales pages and checkout flows. You start with a proven structure instead of a blank page — then make it yours in seconds.

From prompt to funnel

AI that builds your funnel from patterns proven by top sellers. It pulls from what's converting right now and instantly builds pages that do the same for you. Their years of testing, skipped for you.

Conditional logic and A/B testing

Send buyers down different paths based on what they do: take the upsell, skip it, or hesitate at checkout. Then run variants on any page and let the winner take the traffic.

Funnels that optimize themselves

Vibe Funnels watches every page, compares your results against funnels that already convert, and starts new tests on its own. Your numbers go up without you touching anything.
